span.p:
Job number re-keyed in another format
20 finance job codes have no Corvus job
£236k of cost with no production record

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Works order typed by hand
6 works orders that do not exist; 242 hours booked to them
189 shop-floor rows unreadable or duplicated

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Labour allocated apart from bookings
£248k gap summed over jobs
30 jobs out by more than 15%

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NCR cost left blank
45 of 246 NCRs uncosted
Cost of quality understated

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
No works order, heat number or promised date on the note
OTIF 16.7%; 30 notes with no promised date
1,103 tonnes despatched without full traceability

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Invoices raised on unmapped job codes
32 invoices worth £2.02m

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Steel charged to one job, issued to others; works orders left open
£1.43m of material cost on the wrong job
WIP £714k, 54.9% of it over 90 days
